statement: The DualSense output path drives three separate LED functions: an RGB lightbar set by three 8-bit colour bytes, five player-indicator LEDs set by one bitmask byte (bits 0-4), and a microphone-mute LED set by its own mode byte. Each has its own valid bit in the output report.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, VIIPER a370903, nondebug 0233835; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: VIIPER dualsense.md 150-184 (output state names mute light, player LEDs, lightbar); nondebug explorer 192-197, 350-365 (five player LED and mute LED controls); SDL_hidapi_ps5.c 169-192, 711-743; hid-playstation.c 159-163, 270-298. Sources agree on the three functions; no physical brightness, colour accuracy or timing is measured.
